chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mansur ibn Hazim said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who performed tawaf between al-Safa and al-Marwah before he performed tawaf around the House, and he said: 'He performs tawaf around the House, then returns to al-Safa and al-Marwah and performs tawaf between them.'

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Safa (one of the hills in Mecca)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pilgrim performs Sa'i before Tawaf al-Ifadah?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq clarifies the validity of Sa'i performed out of sequence by ruling that it remains valid but requires the pilgrim to complete the Tawaf al-Kaaba first before returning to finish the Sa'i. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that while the order of rituals is recommended for perfection, the essential validity of the Hajj acts is not invalidated by minor procedural deviations, provided the missing component is subsequently fulfilled. The emphasis on returning to Safa and Marwah highlights the integral connection between the two pillars of ritual movement in the Hajj ceremony.
